description: Uses a standalone Gemini conversation to summarize provided data into a professional subject/title and body.
command:
python3 -c '
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import os

data_to_summarize = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
api_base = os.environ.get("API_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000").rstrip("/")
urls = [f"{api_base}/prompt", "http://localhost:8000/prompt", f"{api_base}/summarize"]

payload = json.dumps({"prompt": "Summarize this content into a clean, professional subject and body", "content": data_to_summarize}).encode("utf-8")

success = False
last_err = ""
for url in urls:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            res_data = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            print(res_data)
            success = True
            break
    except Exception as e:
        last_err = str(e)
        continue

if not success:
    print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": f"Failed to reach prompt endpoint: {last_err}"}))
' "${answer1}"
questions: What data or summary should be used to generate the content?*
